claims.head: Cole and Vlasic get the Suzuki assignment
claims.call: The Blackhawks’ P3 (Cole and Vlasic) spends at least 77% of its 5-on-5 time against the Canadiens’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Blackhawks keep sending Cole and Vlasic out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Jeff Blashill has been picking a defense pair for the other team’s top line. Tonight the Canadiens’ first line is Caufield, Suzuki and Slafkovský.
claims.nums: At home: 77% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against first lines, about 39% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, Jeff Blashill likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Canadiens’ first line.
claims.cite: Matchups · Chicago home games this season · 5 games, 56 minutes for this group at 5-on-5

chips.tip: Chicago’s P3 (Cole and Vlasic) at home: 77% of its 5-on-5 time against opponents’ first lines. Matchups, Chicago home games this season, 5 games, 56 minutes for this group at 5-on-5.
With no line matching, this group would face first lines about 39% of the time, about as often as those lines are on the ice.

notes.text: Nick Suzuki is out (upper-body injury), reported after he played in their last game. He is one of their most valuable skaters.

Ivan Demidov is on injured reserve (lower-body injury) and has missed the last 7 games. He is one of their most valuable skaters. Kirby Dach has taken his spot beside Alex Newhook and Juraj Slafkovský.
Mike Matheson has not dressed for the last 4 games. He is a top-pair defenseman. Lane Hutson has taken his spot beside Noah Dobson.
Owen Beck was added to the roster on Oct 14 and has played beside Jake Evans and Kirby Dach.
David Reinbacher was added to the roster on Oct 15.
Owen Beck was added to the roster on Oct 23 and has played beside Jake Evans and Kirby Dach.
Arber Xhekaj has started killing penalties: on the ice for 31% of the team’s shorthanded time in 9 games, up from 6% last season.
Bowen Byram is day to day (upper-body injury) and has missed the last 2 games. He is a top-pair defenseman. Wyatt Kaiser has taken his spot beside Artyom Levshunov.
Dominic Toninato was added to the roster on Oct 14 and has played beside Ryan Donato and Oliver Moore.
Artyom Levshunov is no longer playing on the power play: 5% of the team’s power-play time in 9 games, down from 59% last season.

CHI.head: Not an easy night for the Blackhawks
CHI.body: Even though Chicago has home-ice advantage and Montréal will be without Suzuki, the Canadiens have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Blackhawks’ best way through is getting good looks.

MTL.head: The matchup suits the Canadiens
MTL.body: Even though Chicago has home-ice advantage and Montréal will be without Suzuki, the Canadiens have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Blackhawks’ way back in is getting good looks.

story.head: Somebody warn the Blackhawks’ goalie
paras: The Canadiens come in at 4-3-2, the Blackhawks at 3-6-0.
At home, Jeff Blashill likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Canadiens’ first line. The Habs shoot a lot, and the Blackhawks give up plenty.

items.text: Ian Cole is set to play his 1,000th NHL game.
The Canadiens are newly without Nick Suzuki, and have been without Samuel Montembeault, Ivan Demidov and Mike Matheson for several games. Jacob Fowler is expected to start.
Cole Caufield has a point in at least six straight games against Chicago.
The Blackhawks are newly without Bowen Byram.
